title: Age, and And
label: ch:zh-sui-he
canDo: I can say how old I am in a sentence with no verb in it, and join two nouns with 和 while knowing it may not join two sentences.

payoff.summary: 岁 gives the numerals their first thing to measure, and 和 is the first joining word this track has ever had — one that teaches where it may not go.
